about_the_game:
Broken Fate is a psychological thriller otome visual novel that blends romance, mystery, and slow-burn horror. Set in a beautifully haunting version of ancient Asia, it invites you to investigate, explore, and survive.

The story

You awaken in the serene yet unfamiliar Lotus Pavilion, with no memory of who you are or how you got there. Beside you is Han—a gentle, soft-spoken artist who claims to be your husband. He insists you simply suffered a fall and lost your memory. Everything he does seems devoted to your comfort… but the more you explore your surroundings, the more unsettling things become. Is Han truly who he says he is? And more importantly—who are you? 4 days is all you have to survive and find out the truth.

Features:

🩸Customizable protagonist’s name

🩸A yandere love interest 

🩸Point-and-click investigation and exploration mechanics where you can collect clues and make deductions.

🩸The game is designed to be highly replayable, with a lot of endings and non-linear branchings depending on your investigation and choices

🩸Beautiful anime-style CGs

🩸Psychological thriller storytelling with a slow, creeping sense of dread and a richly atmospheric setting inspired by ancient Asia

🩸Perfect for fans of otome games, yandere characters, and dark romance

Will you trust the one who calls you his beloved—or uncover the fate that truly awaits you?

The base game is free and includes most of the romance endings, but we also offer two optional DLCs that greatly expand the experience. These downloadable content packs unlock darker secrets, deeper relationships, and impactful new choices not available in the base game. If you enjoy the story, getting a DLC is also the best way to support me and our small team.

I recommend choosing just one DLC, based on your age and personal preference:

📍 Location Expansion Pack

  • Unlock a hidden area of the mansion

  • Access new storylines and endings tied to this location

  • Romance a secret love interest

  • 5+ additional endings

❤️ Full Expansion Pack (Intended for mature audiences)
Includes everything from the Location Expansion Pack, plus:

  • 6 extra romantic CG illustrations

  • Erotic romance choices

  • Erotic CGs

  • 5+ additional endings
